meta.notes: M1 and M2 are mobile manipulators and can carry payloads, so they are best for tasks that require picking up and moving items. D1 is a drone and can quickly fly to and from the solar canopy and office roof. G1 can carry heavier payloads and is suited for tasks that require moving larger items. A1 is stationary and can only work in the workcell West. The tasks are prioritized based on their deadlines and the capabilities of the robots.
